title: Mission Ammunition
description:
The most secure prison facility in the country
is under attack ... 
The city mayor called personally and asked you to take care of this problem. 
You are Jake, ex-military and a member of Team . 

Mission Ammunition is a modern action game with a lot of justified pixel violence and the clever platforming.

 

 Over 30 levels of action
 Ultra-sharp and detailed pixel art 
 Super-tough boss fights 
 Very reasonable number of powerful guns 
 Great accompanying music 
 Top secret locations 
 Spectacular explosions

 Pure old-school awesomeness
